sources.title: Cezar repository
sources.finding: open-mercato/cezar: 1072 stars on 2026-11-16, MIT, latest release v0.20.0 (2026-11-15), homepage cezar.run; separate desktop-v0.1.x releases.

sources.title: Cezar README
sources.locator: Features, Screenshots, Quick start, How it works, Automations, Task dispatch
sources.finding: Open-source orchestrator running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and others in parallel locally or on a VPS; per-task git worktrees with queue; Autonomous mode; live view with tokens and cost; variants; skills and YAML workflows; GitHub/Jira/Linear; automations; child task dispatch (four in flight); no database; phone-responsive cockpit.

sources.title: cezar reference
sources.locator: Core concepts, Cockpit tour, Multiple projects, Automatic agent fallback, How it runs agents, API, Coding agent backends, Remote access, Configuration, Worktree lifecycle scripts
sources.finding: Task run states, FIFO queue with maxParallel (default 2), memory-aware runs, worktree retention, review gate, agent backends and tool limits, HTTP API under /api/v1 with no built-in auth, server-install, config keys, worktree lifecycle hooks, environment flags (dispatch, managers, automations, terminal).

sources.title: Telemetry
sources.finding: Telemetry is opt-in: nothing is sent until the user answers yes in the cockpit, Settings > Privacy or cezar telemetry enable; CEZ_TELEMETRY=0 and DO_NOT_TRACK block it; event list given.

sources.title: Jira Cloud and Linear
sources.locator: Connect, Storage and isolation, Credentials and read permissions
sources.finding: Per-project Jira Cloud or Linear connection to browse issues and launch tasks; read-only browsing; event automations; credentials encrypted AES-256-GCM with keychain; per-session tracker capability for read/comment/transition on the task's own issue.

sources.title: Ubuntu VPS install
sources.finding: server-install sets up nginx with auth_basic and Let's Encrypt HTTPS plus a systemd service and verifies an anonymous request is challenged; external-proxy mode requires the user's own proxy auth.

sources.title: Code signing policy
sources.finding: Windows desktop installer is signed via SignPath; macOS builds signed per Apple scheme; Linux packages unsigned.

sources.title: E2E verification
sources.finding: Browser and mobile e2e runs can be a verification step that gates a task.

sources.title: Webhooks receiver guide
sources.finding: Opt-in (CEZ_WEBHOOKS=1) signed JSON project lifecycle webhooks with native Slack/Discord notifications.

sources.title: Cezar desktop release assets
sources.finding: Desktop assets: macOS aarch64 and x86_64 dmg, Linux x86_64 AppImage, deb and pkg.tar.zst, Windows x86_64 setup exe, desktop-latest.json; no ARM Linux/Windows build, no mobile app.

sources.title: Tauri desktop configuration
sources.locator: productName Cezar, version 0.1.11, bundle targets ["app"], macOS minimumSystemVersion 12.0, updater endpoint
sources.finding: Desktop shell is Tauri 2 (src-tauri) bundling the pre-built cockpit UI (frontendDist ../ui); macOS 12+ minimum; updater via GitHub release JSON.

sources.title: AgentRunner interface source
sources.finding: Single AgentRunner seam normalising agent CLI output into events; backends implemented as classes for Claude, Codex, Junie, OpenCode, Cursor, pi and further CLIs.

sources.title: cezar npm package manifest
sources.finding: Published npm package @open-mercato/cezar 0.20.0 exposing the cezar/cez/cezar-run binaries; Node >=20.

sources.title: API client package
sources.finding: Typed client and contract types for the cockpit HTTP API in the monorepo; marked private (not published).

sources.title: Task dispatch source directory
sources.finding: Dispatch implementation: parent/child task tree with briefs, orders, notes, reports and per-task inbox files.

sources.title: Automations coordinator source
sources.finding: Automations coordinator schedules GitHub/tracker-triggered and calendar automations that launch ordinary tasks.

sources.title: Managers source
sources.finding: Manager agents (global long-lived chat agents connected to projects) with a cez-manager CLI and connectors.

sources.title: Cezar telemetry doc at v0.20.0
sources.finding: At v0.20.0 telemetry is opt-in: nothing is sent until the user says yes in the bottom-bar question; Settings > Privacy offers the same answer as a switch; CEZ_TELEMETRY=0 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 also disable it.
